description: This file defines a custom ListView class 'TaskListView' that enhances accessibility support by adding additional accessibility events, and an adapter class 'TaskAdapter' that provides views for list items with accessibility-enhanced properties.

classes.name: TaskListView
classes.description: A custom ListView subclass that overrides onRequestSendAccessibilityEvent to add additional accessibility information related to the child's priority.

classes.name: TaskAdapter
classes.description: An adapter extending BaseAdapter to provide views for list items, setting content descriptions to enhance accessibility features.

methods.name: TaskListView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the custom ListView with context and attribute set.

methods.name: onRequestSendAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Override that adds a custom content description containing the child's priority to the accessibility event.

methods.name: TaskAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with context, labels, and checkbox states.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of list items.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a list item view, sets checkbox state and label text, and assigns a content description for accessibility.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the label at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as item ID.
